mapper.select: SELECT d.document_id documentId, d.title title, d.content content, d.uploaded_time uploadedTime, e.name AS uploaderName, d.status status FROM document d JOIN employee e ON d.uploader_id = e.id ORDER BY d.document_id DESC LIMIT #{rowPerPage} offset #{startRow};

SELECT d.document_id documentId, d.title title, d.content content, d.uploaded_time uploadedTime, d.uploader_id uploaderId, d.status status, e.name AS uploaderName FROM document d JOIN employee e ON d.uploader_id = e.id WHERE d.document_id = #{documentId};
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE document_id = #{documentId};
UPDATE document SET status = #{signStatus} WHERE document_Id = #{documentId};
